$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Upload requests, and the verdict each check gives them.
headers: name/value pairs in order; the value "{length}" stands for the body's length in bytes. body: the body as text, sent as UTF-8; or bodyBase64: the body's bytes, for a body that is not UTF-8.
gateway: what the printer's gateway does with this request as a remote POST /server/files/upload: "ok" (it rebuilds the body and forwards it), or the status it refuses it with (checkUpload).
print: the same under the rules a client of this package also keeps (checkPrintUpload).
